prompt: Customers who retry checkout after a failed payment sometimes see a stale pending order or a duplicate invoice. Retrying checkout should keep the cart stable, avoid duplicate invoices, and allow a fresh payment attempt when needed.
issue_title: Retrying checkout after a failed payment shows a stale pending order
issue_body: Customers who retry checkout after a failed payment sometimes see a stale pending order or a duplicate invoice. Retrying checkout should keep the cart stable, avoid duplicate invoices, and allow a fresh payment attempt when needed.
expected_behavior: A same-cart retry reuses the existing pending order and its invoice.
A changed-cart retry creates a new order.
A failed attempt does not block a later successful payment.
There is at most one invoice per order.
expected_failure_summary: CheckoutService::checkout no longer looks up an existing pending order with a matching cart fingerprint for the session, so a same-cart retry always creates a fresh order and a second invoice.
task_author_notes: Restore the reuse loop over db->sessionOrders[sessionId] that returns an existing PENDING order whose orderFingerprints entry matches the cart fingerprint. same_cart_retry_reuses_order and invoice_count_stable fail on broken; others pass.
